spans.s: Disappearance, dissolution, extinction, destruction; universal destruction (प्रलय); लयं या 'to be dissolved or destroyed'.
Absorption of the mind, deep concentration, exclusive devotion (to any one object); पश्यन्ती शिवरूपिणं लयवशादात्मानमभ्यागता
Time in music (of three kinds- द्रुत, मध्य, and विलम्बित); किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः
A place of rest, abode, habitation; अलया Śi.4.57 'having no fixed abode, wandering'.
Slackness of mind, mental inactivity; (also used in adjectival sense; यदा जये- द्रजः सत्त्वं तमो मूढं लयं जडम्
The union of song, dance, and instrumental music; गायतं मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम्

The quick (downward) movement of an arrow. -Comp. -अर्कः the sun at the destruction of the universe.-आरम्भः, -आलम्भः an actor, a dancer. -कालः the time of destruction (of the world.). -गत a. dissolved, melted away. -नालिकः a Buddhist or Jain temple.-पुत्री an actress, a female dancer. -मध्य a. to be performed in moderate time (a piece of music). -शुद्धa. to be performed in right time. -स्थानम् a place of dissolution.
